_meta.name: onemedical-export-records
_meta.description: Navigate One Medical patient portal, collect visit summaries, lab results, prescriptions, and trigger PDF/FHIR exports.
_meta.authStrategy: Google SSO (mw@mike-wolf.com) or email/password — interactive first run required
exportFormats: FHIR R4 via patient access API (21st Century Cures)
anomalies: Amazon-owned SPA — heavy React; navigate alone may not populate records, use perceive or delay
Visit summaries are per-visit PDFs, not a bulk export — must iterate over visit list
FHIR API requires separate OAuth flow at fhir.onemedical.com — not automated here

chain.note: Landing page. Will redirect to login if not authenticated.
If redirected to login, halt and prompt Mike to authenticate manually. Resume from s3 after auth.
Health overview / records section. Exact path may vary — perceive to confirm navigation.
Capture page structure to identify links: Visit Summaries, Lab Results, Medications, Documents.
Navigate to visit list. One Medical uses React router — links may be text-clickable.
settle (was delay 2000ms); resolves on content root, proceeds on timeout
Capture list of visits with dates and provider names. rowCount = number of past visits available.
Download visit summary PDF for most recent visit. Repeat loop over visit_list for full history — not automated in v1.
Lab results section. May also be /results or /labs.
settle (was delay 2000ms); resolves on content root, proceeds on timeout
Capture lab results list: test name, date, result, reference range, ordering provider.
Capture document list. Note any CCDA or CCD export buttons.

auth-sentinel.note: One Medical SPA — selector unverified. Use URL pattern /health or /home as primary auth check.

visit-list-item.description: Individual visit row in visit history
visit-list-item.note: Unverified — perceive visit_list to discover actual selectors on first run.

download-pdf-button.description: Download PDF button for visit summary
download-pdf-button.note: Unverified. Fall back to click_text('Download') if CSS selector fails.

fhirExportNote: One Medical exposes a FHIR R4 patient access endpoint. Authorization requires a separate OAuth 2.0 flow via developer.onemedical.com. Not automated in this payload — requires API key or patient-facing OAuth. For bulk export, consider the FHIR path over scraping.
